caption: The drawing shows a rectangular composition with a decorative border in shades of pink, red, black, and brown. In the center, there is a large golden-yellow ornamental vase or urn, filled with green leafy plants and surrounded by an abundance of pink, red, and coral-colored flowers with white and green leaves against a black background. Flanking the vase on either side are two white or cream-colored dogs sitting on their haunches, facing the vase. Both dogs have black noses and eyes and are positioned symmetrically. There are also two small blue and black birds, one perched near each dog, facing the center. The floral patterns feature swirling green stems and petals, and the composition is closely packed with plant motifs. Near the top center of the rectangle, a brown keyhole plate is visible, suggesting the placement on a box or chest. The overall style is characterized by bold, contrasting colors and stylized, decorative forms.
title: Sp. Col. Chest
